releases.title: Late Night with Seth Meyers

Meyers takes his departure from "SNL" to his new post at "Late Night," as Jimmy Fallon moves to "The Tonight Show".

releases.title: MobLand

releases.title: Binnelanders

releases.title: The View
releases.synopsis: ABC Daytime's morning chatfest, currently featuring Whoopi Goldberg, Joy Behar, Sunny Hostin, Sara Haines, Alyssa Farah Griffin, and Ana Navarro discussing the most exciting events of the day. Hot topics in the news, the best experts in their field, celebrity interviews and general entertainment are all part of The View.

releases.title: Jeopardy!

releases.title: Coronation Street
releases.synopsis: The residents of Coronation Street are ordinary, working-class people, and the show follows them through regular social and family interactions at home, in the workplace, and in their local pub, the Rovers Return Inn. Britain's longest-running soap.

releases.title: Home Alone
releases.synopsis: It can be a badge of honor to be “single.” “I Live Alone” is a documentary-style South Korean reality series that follows the members of a self-formed club called Rainbow, which is comprised of  celebrities who are single and live alone.

releases.title: Tomorrow Is Ours
releases.synopsis: The story revolves around the people of Sète, France. Their lives are punctuated by family rivalries, romance and scenes from daily life, but also by plots involving police investigations, secrets and betrayals.

releases.title: The Graham Norton Show
releases.synopsis: Each week celebrity guests join Irish comedian Graham Norton to discuss what's being going on around the world that week. The guests poke fun and share their opinions on the main news stories. Graham is often joined by a band or artist to play the show out.

releases.synopsis: This television drama series is centered around the prestigious culinary school of renowned chef Auguste Armand. releases.title: Secret Lives
releases.synopsis: Salatut elämät (Secret Lives) is a Finnish television soap opera that premiered on MTV3 on 25 January 1999. The series' storylines follow the daily lives of several families who live in the same apartment block in Helsinki.

releases.title: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure
releases.synopsis: Follow the intergenerational feud between the Joestar Family and various forces of evil, the most prominent of which is Dio Brando and his followers.

releases.title: Hello Saturday
releases.synopsis:
"Hello, Saturday" is the rebranding of the popular Chinese show "Happy Camp", hosted by He Jiong and with a fixed group of regular celebrity members.

The program showcases the talent of various stars as well as social topics through creative and diverse content and games. It aims to spread positive energy while keeping up with the current trends and leading youth culture.

releases.title: Ulice
releases.synopsis:
Ulice is a Czech soap opera produced and broadcast by Nova. In the Czech language Ulice means street.

The show describes the lives of the Farský, Jordán, Boháč, Nikl, and Liška families and many other people that live in Prague. Their daily battle against real problems of living in a modern world like divorce, love, betrayal and illness or disease. Ulice often shows crime.

releases.title: Detective Conan
releases.synopsis: The son of a world famous mystery writer, Jimmy Kudo, has achieved his own notoriety by assisting the local police as a student detective. He has always been able to solve the most difficult of criminal cases using his wits and power of reason.

releases.title: Dark Matter
releases.synopsis: Hailed as one of the best sci-fi novels of the decade, Dark Matter is a story about the road not taken. The series follows Jason Dessen, a physicist, professor, and family man who – one night while walking home on the streets of Chicago – is abducted into an alternate version of his life. Wonder quickly turns to nightmare when he tries to return to his reality amid the multiverse of lives he could have lived. In this labyrinth of mind-bending realities, he embarks on a harrowing journey to get back to his true family and save them from the most terrifying, unbeatable foe imaginable: himself.

releases.title: Emmerdale
releases.synopsis: The lives of several families in the Yorkshire Dales revolve around a farm and the nearby village. With murders, affairs, lies, deceit, laughter and tears, it's all there in the village.

releases.title: Outlander: Blood of My Blood
releases.synopsis: Outlander: Blood of My Blood explores the lives and relationship of Claire's parents, Julia Moriston and Henry Beauchamp, and Jamie's parents, Ellen MacKenzie and Brian Fraser. The series centers on these two parallel love stories set in two different time periods, with Jamie's parents in the early 18th-century Scottish Highlands and Claire's parents in WWI England.

releases.title: Anna Pigeon
releases.synopsis: Anna Pigeon is a former city slicker who became a park ranger after a devastating loss changed the trajectory of her life forever. While Anna tries to outrun her demons, her focus turns to solving crimes that have taken place within national park grounds, no matter who or what gets in her way.

releases.title: Fightland
releases.synopsis: Fightland follows a disgraced, formerly incarcerated boxing champion who returns to London to seek vengeance against the crime family he thinks betrayed him. With edge-of-seat action and populated by dangerous characters, this is a world of money and power never seen before.On the night Duke Kilroy becomes world heavyweight champion, a vicious assault leaves his brother, Calvin, dead, causing Duke to snap and results in him spending eight years in a U.S. prison. Upon his release, and after having made a sinister discovery, Duke returns home seeking vengeance against the man he believes set him up -- the criminal kingpin and former promoter, Kingsley Marshall. But Kingsley has vanished, leaving his children and wife, Joy, who happens to be the love of Duke's life, to pick up the pieces.Working with a cartel desperate to control London's drug market, Duke begins a high-risk game of infiltrating Kingsley's empire to destroy it from within and smoke out his enemy. But amidst a volatile criminal landscape, and competing influences threatening to pull him off course, Duke will need to channel everything that made him a champion fighter into his bloody pursuit to win the ultimate victory - revenge for his brother.

releases.title: On Patrol: Live
releases.synopsis: Hosting and executive producing On Patrol: Live is Dan Abrams, CEO and Founder of Abrams Media, host of Dan Abrams Live on NewsNation, Chief Legal Analyst for ABC News, and former host of Live PD. Joining Abrams is Sgt. Sean "Sticks" Larkin, retired Tulsa Police Department lieutenant with nearly 25 years of service, and Deputy Sheriff Curtis Wilson, Division Commander with the Richland County Sheriff's Department in Columbia, SC.

releases.title: Dragons' Den

releases.title: Big Brother

The iconic house has had a fresh lick of paint and is ready to welcome a brand-new cast of housemates from all walks of life as they take up residence in the Big Brother house, so join hosts AJ Odudu and Will Best for all of the action from their first week there!

releases.title: Gogglebox
releases.synopsis: Gogglebox is a British observational documentary television show which has aired on Channel 4 since 2013. The show focuses on families, friends and couples from around the country in their living rooms watching the last week's of British television.

releases.title: LINK CLICK
releases.synopsis: In a modern metropolis there is a small store called "Time Photo Studio." Although only a few customers come to visit, it's actually run by Cheng Xiaoshi and Lu Guang, two men with special powers. They cooperate and use their super powers to enter the photos in order to fulfil the client's request. However, things always get out of their control...

releases.title: Cook's Country from America's Test Kitchen
releases.synopsis: "Cook's Country from America's Test Kitchen" is a half-hour cooking show distributed to public television stations (reruns airing on Create) in the United States, which are also available in most Canadian markets. The show's hosts are Julia Collin Davison & Bridget Lancaster; the show and the magazine are affiliated, and the magazine's test kitchen facility in Brookline, Massachusetts, is used as a set for the show. Cook's Illustrated's parent company, Boston Common Press, while retaining its corporate name, has marketed its publishing and media activities under the America's Test Kitchen brand beginning in 2004.

releases.title: The Loud House
releases.synopsis: Welcome to the Loud House, where life can get pretty crazy. One boy, TEN girls?! Lincoln Loud wouldn't change it for the world!

releases.title: The Wargame
releases.synopsis: The Wargame takes viewers beyond the news cycle and behind closed doors into a sealed COBR-style crisis room where real-world senior politicians, military leaders and intelligence chiefs are challenged to confront a high-stakes scenario: a Russian attack on UK soil.Set six months in the future, this gripping simulation has been developed in conjunction with leading academics, military and defence experts, including Sky News' Security and Defence Editor Deborah Haynes, to replicate the pressure of political decision-making at the highest level.Rolling news bulletins, social media footage, military and intelligence reports and unexpected interventions throw up a series of minute-by-minute dilemmas, forcing the ‘Cabinet' to grapple with decisions that could affect us all. A provocative stress test on our leaders, our institutions and the country itself, this unmissable event television will prompt us all to engage with our new geopolitical reality.

releases.title: Judy Justice
releases.synopsis: The Honorable Judy Sheindlin, retired Judge of the Manhattan family Court, brings her signature blend of sharp wit and wisdom, hilarious candor and unwavering honesty that has made her America's favorite judge for over 25 years, as she presides over real cases, arbitrates binding decisions and delivers what only she can: Judy Justice.

releases.title: Chronicles of the Sun
releases.synopsis: Claire is surprised when she gets arrested for the murder of her childhood friend after she returns to Montpellier.

releases.title: NBC Nightly News
releases.synopsis: NBC Nightly News is the most-watched evening newscast in America, providing the very latest on the day's top stories and going beyond the headlines to add context and analysis to the most pressing issues of our time, both at home and abroad. We go to the heart of breaking news stories, introduce you to everyday people caught up in extraordinary events, offer in-depth reporting on health and medicine, cover international news as it unfolds and we profile those who inspire us to do better in our popular Making A Difference reports. The award-winning broadcast carries a legacy that spans more than six decades, beginning in 1948 - when NBC started broadcasting television's first-ever regularly scheduled network evening newscast.

releases.title: Scariest House in America
releases.synopsis: Comedian Retta travels across the country to courageously tour homes full of haunts, frights and scares. After crowning the most terrifying house of them all, designer Alison Victoria surprises the homeowners with a scary-good $150,000 renovation!

releases.title: Formula 1

releases.title: Knife Edge: Chasing Michelin Stars

releases.title: 4 Blocks Zero
releases.synopsis: The prequel to the award-winning gangster drama ‘4 Blocks' tells the story of the Hamadys in 1990s Berlin: having fled Lebanon and only accepted as tolerated refugees in Germany, they struggle to gain a foothold in their new home. Who are they, how did the family become the most influential clan in the city, and how did Ali eventually become Toni?

releases.title: El problema final
releases.synopsis: In the spring of 1959, thirteen people were stuck by a violent storm on a small islet near Mallorca. Any of them could anticipate what is about to happen at the small hotel where they're staying: Elisa Mander, a discreet British tourist, is found dead. What initially seems like a suicide soon raises unsettling signs—it may in fact be murder. Basil, a retired actor once famous for portraying none other than Sherlock Holmes on the big screen, finds himself unexpectedly tasked with unravelling the case. In a place no one can leave—and no one can reach—every guest and staff member becomes a suspect in a crime that grows more intricate and twisted by the minute.

releases.title: WWE Friday Night SmackDown

releases.title: The Last Word with Lawrence O'Donnell

releases.title: Antiques Road Trip
releases.synopsis: Antiques experts compete against one another at various auctions across the country to try and earn the most money by the end of the week.

releases.title: Drag Race Philippines
releases.synopsis: The hit global drag phenomenon is now in the Philippines! Watch as 12 iconic queens slay and race to the finish line and compete to be the first ever Drag Race Superstar from the Philippines. It's the Filipinos' time to shine, henny... and you ain't seen nothing yet!

releases.title: Today
releases.synopsis: Today is an American news and talk morning television show that airs on NBC. The program debuted on January 14, 1952. It was the first of its genre on American television and in the world, and is the fifth-longest-running American television series.

releases.title: Anderson Cooper 360°
releases.synopsis: Anderson Cooper 360° (commonly shortened to either AC-360 or 360) is a television news show on CNN, hosted by the American journalist Anderson Cooper. The program covers a number of news stories of the day, usually through live or taped reports from the network's correspondents. The coverage can also include analysis from experts on the issues, commonly featured in or after the taped reports.

releases.title: Arafta
releases.synopsis: Ateş, a man haunted by childhood scars and consumed by rage, returns to destroy the family that shattered his life years ago. His weapon is not a sword, but a marriage: 187 days with Mercan, the daughter of his enemy. Mercan, already promised to Nezir, is thrust into a battle she never chose, while Ateş binds her to him believing she is the key to his revenge. Yet the woman he intends to destroy becomes the one who threatens to undo him. And in the shadows, Aslı – driven by jealousy, seizes every chance to tear them apart. Suspended between love's salvation and fate's cruelty, Arafta is a saga of passion and payback, where every choice risks turning fire into ashes.

releases.title: Paolo
releases.synopsis: Paolo's ordinary working-class existence is upended when he encounters the ambitious, and magnetic local politician Téophane, an old school mate. What begins as admiration and a desire to help Téophane's campaign, soon spirals into an all-consuming obsession, leading to a deadly ride in this intense psychological Ripley-style thriller.

releases.title: CBS Evening News
releases.synopsis: The CBS Evening News, a daily evening broadcast featuring news reports, feature stories and interviews by CBS News correspondents and reporters covering events across world.

releases.synopsis: On Patrol: Live's Dan Abrams, Sean "Sticks" Larkin, and Curtis Wilson provide a sneak peek at tonight's On Patrol: Live and share favorite moments from previous programs.

releases.title: Physical Italia: da 100 a 1

releases.title: Deadline: White House

Nicolle Wallace brings viewers the latest political developments of the day, in addition to interviews with leading newsmakers and influential politicians. Drawing on her years of experience as communications chief for President George W. Bush and senior advisor for the McCain-Palin campaign, Wallace provides political insight and clarity on where key decision-makers stand on complex issues.

releases.title: The Five
releases.synopsis: The Five is an American news and talk show on Fox News Channel featuring a rotating panel who discuss current stories, political issues, and pop culture. The show premiered in July 2011, replacing the Glenn Beck program, and airs on weekdays at 5:00 p.m. ET with replays at 4:00 a.m. ET. On October 3, 2011, after successful ratings and high popularity, Fox News announced that The Five would become the permanent 5 p.m. series, as the program had previously been announced to last only during the summer. The Five is currently the second-most-watched program in all of cable news in the United States, placing only behind The O'Reilly Factor, also on the Fox News Channel. The program has occasionally been the number one rated cable news series in the key 25 to 54 viewing demographic.

releases.title: JAŸ-Z IN 8
releases.synopsis: 30 years after his landmark debut album "Reasonable Doubt," artist, icon, philanthropist, entrepreneur JAŸ-Z sits down with longtime friend, producer, and director Rick Rubin for an intimate reflection on his storied career, revisiting the music together and unpacking his work and life through a shared listening and illuminating conversation. Featuring many of JAŸ-Z's iconic tracks and album cuts, including "99 Problems," "Brooklyn's Finest," and "4:44," the eight-episode series offers a deeply revealing portrait of the artist and his work, exploring the influences and inspiration that shaped both the man and his music.

releases.title: Loose Women
releases.synopsis: A weekday panel show presented by women for women. Watch our panellists discuss topical issues & showbiz while interviewing celebrity guests in front of a live studio audience.

releases.title: Steel Ball Run: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure
releases.synopsis: America, 1890. Johnny Joestar, a genius jockey now paralyzed from the waist down, chases after outlaw Gyro Zeppeli in a tough cross-continent horse race.

releases.title: Totally Funny Animals
releases.synopsis: Totally Funny Animals features caught-on-camera videos that highlight the outrageous and wacky world of animals. Hosted by comedian Andy Woodhull, this clip show features everything from sneezing cats and calamitous canines to dumpster-diving bears and rascally racoons.

releases.title: Cang Yuan Tu
releases.synopsis: The story tells the story of Meng Chuan, the protagonist, who has made a vow to avenge his mother's death since he was a child and takes the Mirror Lake Daoist College as his starting point. With his resolute and fearless heart and decisive sword skills, he punishes the evil, destroys the demons, ascends to the top of the four Daoist Colleges, becomes famous in the Dongning Province, pays homage to the Yuanchu Mountain, and achieves a generation of gods and demons.(DeepL)

releases.title: Pushpa Impossible
releases.synopsis: Pushpa Impossible is the story about a feisty middle-aged woman having studied until grade 9 in a Gujarati medium school and going back to school at the age of 44! She is boisterous, uncouth, impulsive, hardworking and an endearingly loveable mother of three children. She is Pushpa Patel hailing from a small town Patan in Gujarat and now residing at Bapodra Chawl in Mumbai. The show is a peek into her day-to-day struggles, her small victories, her Juggad, her shortcomings, and her constant pursuit of living a good life while struggling as a full-time mother and part-time businesswoman. The show is an autobiography of a mother, who decides to go back to school and change her life by impacting many lives!

releases.title: ABC World News Now
releases.synopsis: ABC World News Now gives viewers up-to-date information on current events and news from around the world, airing in the overnight hours. Its tone is somewhat lighter than a regular news broadcast, though reports are filed from the usual ABC News correspondents. Weather and pop culture stories round out the reports.

releases.title: The Beat with Ari Melber
releases.synopsis: The Beat with Ari Melber delivers the biggest political and news stories of the day, with interviews and original reporting from around the nation. An Emmy-winning journalist, attorney and former Senate staffer, Melber cuts through the spin and the noise to tell you what's really happening. Real news, every night.

releases.title: The Great Ruler
releases.synopsis: In the vast world, planes converge and numerous races thrive. A gathering of extraordinary talents unfolds, where one after another, supreme beings from the lower planes come forth. In this boundless realm, they weave captivating legends that inspire admiration, pursuing the path to dominance.

releases.title: Morning Joe
releases.synopsis: On Morning Joe, the hosts Joe Scarborough, Mika Brzezinski, and Willie Geist engage in dynamic discussion about political news and issues important to all Americans. Morning Joe attracts a variety of guests, including top newsmakers, politicians and cultural influencers.

releases.title: Hannity
releases.synopsis: Sean Hannity interviews political figures and newsmakers and offers his own perspective.

releases.title: Age Inappropriate
releases.synopsis: Age gap relationships are layered with complexities of power dynamics, family pressure, stereotypes, financial imbalance and yes, true love. Experience, money and life stage are powerful forces that can turn passion into pressure, sexual chemistry into combustion and ultimately, love into hate. Can couples separated by decades truly build a lasting love, or is the writing already on the wall? Age Inappropriate, seeks to uncover the answer, exploring the how and why behind what makes these relationships work - or fall completely apart.

releases.title: Gutfeld!
releases.synopsis: Late night show with author, comedian and television host and producer Greg Gutfeld, offering up satirical political and social commentary with a weekly panel of guests.

releases.title: Help! We Bought a Village

releases.title: Honor Thy Mother
releases.synopsis: A powerful CEO and a struggling actress from opposite worlds are forced into an unlikely partnership to rescue a company in crisis. As they fight to rebuild its reputation, old betrayals and lingering resentment resurface, putting both their fragile partnership and their chance at redemption to the ultimate test.

releases.title: Special Report
releases.synopsis: Special Report with Bret Baier (formerly Special Report with Brit Hume) is an American television news and political commentary program appearing on Fox News Channel, currently hosted by Bret Baier. It airs live each Monday through Friday at 6:00 PM ET. The show focuses on both reporting and analysis of the day's events, with a primary focus on national political news. The show has been a part of the Fox News program lineup since 1998 and is the number one cable news broadcast in its time slot.

releases.title: Live From The Lycett Arms

releases.title: Quotidien

The show is hosted by Yann Barthès and produced by Bangumi. It consists of segments and reports produced by the team of commentators and journalists surrounding Yann Barthès and features daily guests including newsmakers, intellectuals, politicians, and French and international celebrities.

releases.title: FOX & Friends
releases.synopsis: FOX & Friends is a conservative American early-morning news and opinion talk show on the Fox News Channel. It begins at 6:00 a.m. Eastern Time with the latest Fox News Live headlines and news of the morning and continues with a variety of segments including current events, interviews, updates of news stories with correspondents, right-leaning analysis from the hosts, and entertainment segments.

releases.title: America's Newsroom

Smith, Max Kellerman and Molly Qerim who are joined by regular contributors and special guests. The show includes daily sports news, interviews with sports journalists, athletes and personalities, spirited debates, and an assortment of other topics. The show debuted 7 May 2007 as "Cold Pizza".

releases.synopsis: Bloomberg Surveillance is presented by Tom Keene, Scarlet Fu and Adam John. The show will bring an insight of business stories from economics, finance and investments.

releases.title: Good Morning Football
releases.synopsis: Prior to the start of the 2016 NFL regular season, NFL Network has announced a new daily morning show, Good Morning Football, premiering Monday, August 1. Hosted by Kay Adams, Nate Burleson, Peter Schrager and Kyle Brandt, and Executive Produced by Michael Davies, Good Morning Football airs live Monday–Friday at 7:00 a.m. ET on NFL Network from CBS Broadcast Center in New York City. The three-hour live show is NFL Network's first show to originate from New York City in the network's nearly 13 year history. Good Morning Football will re-air Monday–Friday starting at 10:00 a.m. ET.

releases.title: A Winter Sun Wakes the Wind in Spring Hills' Dream
releases.synopsis: At the peak of his career, top celebrity Feng Qinglang escapes to a remote tea mountain, seeking a brief respite from the spotlight. Instead, he meets Xu Changyang, a free-spirited young tea farmer with an untamed soul. One belongs to the dazzling world of fame, the other to the forests and the land. As they grow closer among the mountains and wilderness, love quietly takes root. But the relentless scrutiny of the entertainment industry and the harsh realities of society soon close in, pushing them toward separation time and again. In the end, will they follow the call of their hearts and risk everything for love?

releases.title: Way Too Early
releases.synopsis: The fast-paced program brings viewers everything they need to know to start their days--from news and politics to sports and pop culture.

releases.title: Bloomberg Technology
releases.synopsis: The only daily news program focused exclusively on technology, innovation and the future of business from San Francisco. Hosted by Emily Chang.

releases.title: Mad Money
releases.synopsis: Mad Money is an American finance television program hosted by Jim Cramer that began airing on CNBC on March 14, 2005. Its main focus is investment and speculation, particularly in publicly traded stocks. In a notable departure from the CNBC programming style prior to its arrival, Mad Money presents itself in an entertainment-style format rather than a news broadcasting one. Cramer defines "mad money" as the money one "can use to invest in stocks ... not retirement money, which you want in 401K or an IRA, a savings account, bonds, or the most conservative of dividend-paying stocks." Mad Money replaced Dylan Ratigan's Bullseye for the 6 p.m. Eastern Time slot. On January 8, 2007, CNBC began airing reruns of the show at 11 p.m. Eastern Time, on Monday through Friday, and at 4 a.m. Eastern Time, on Saturdays.In March 2012, the program became a part of what was formerly branded as NBC All Night in the nominal 3:07 a.m. ET/2:07 a.m. timeslot on weeknights, replacing week-delayed repeats of NBC's late night talk shows. In that form, only the video for the program was presented on a 16:9 screen with gray branded windowboxing andpillarboxing, with all enhanced business information, including the CNBC Ticker, removed. Because of the scheduling of local station's 4 a.m. or 4:30 a.m. newscasts to airEarly Today depending on how a station schedules its overnight programming (even if it airs at the regular time in the Eastern and Pacific time zones for instance, seven minutes would have to be cut-off to fit in Early Today and a local newscast starting at 4:30 a.m.), it is subject to local pre-emption, including by NBC O&O's.On August 4, 2014, Mad Money was first broadcast in full 1080i HD, resulting in the removal of the sidebar that was seen on all of CNBC's other trading-day programming, until the sidebar itself was permanently removed altogether on October 13, 2014. The NBC presentation displays the native widescreen HD picture, albeit with the CNBC Ticker space still filled in with gray windowboxing.

releases.title: The 11th Hour with Ali Velshi
releases.synopsis: Ali Velshi delivers sharp, data-driven analysis of the day's biggest stories.

releases.title: Outnumbered
releases.synopsis: Featuring an ensemble of four female panelists and one rotating male, Outnumbered examines the top news stories as well as the leading pop culture and relationship issues dominating the headlines. FNC's Harris Faulkner, Kayleigh McEnany and Emily Compagno lead the program's coverage, while alternating co-panelists weigh in with analysis.

releases.title: Chiikawa
releases.synopsis: The story follows the sometimes happy, sometimes sad, and a tad stressful daily life of "some sort of small, cute creature" (Nanka Chiisakute Kawaii Yatsu) known as Chiikawa. Chiikawa enjoys delicious food with bees and rabbits, toils hard every day for the rewards of work, and still maintains a smile.

releases.title: Firing Line with Margaret Hoover
releases.synopsis: Firing Line with Margaret Hoover maintains the character of the original, providing a platform that is diligent in its commitment to civility and the rigorous exchange of opinion. Interviews and debates will highlight leading lights from the left and right, complemented by archival footage from the original Firing Line to remind viewers of longstanding conservative and liberal arguments, where they've been disproved or reinforced over time.

releases.title: Summertime
releases.synopsis: Cha Do-hyeon and Yeo Eun-ho are neighbors and best friends who have grown up together, inseparable for 19 years. Eun-ho has always believed they are closer than family, never realizing that Do-hyeon's longtime crush has already gone far beyond friendship. When a transfer student suddenly enters their lives, jealousy and possessiveness push Do-hyeon to lose his composure. As his most familiar friend begins acting strangely, Eun-ho is forced to reconsider what their relationship really means. This summer, will 19 years of feelings finally cross the line?

releases.title: Scènes de ménages
releases.synopsis: Scènes de ménages depicts the daily lives of several couples from different generations, illustrating with humor their arguments, tender moments and little idiosyncrasies. Each episode is made up of short sketches, in which the characters exchange scathing retorts and funny situations.

releases.title: La promesa
releases.synopsis: In 1913 Spain, a woman gets a job at the palace of La Promesa as a reward for saving the marquesses' son - but nobody knows that she has her own plans, which involve avenging her mother's death and finding her missing brother.

releases.title: FOX & Friends First
releases.synopsis: Kicking off the day, FOX & Friends First delivers all the headlines viewers may have missed overnight, along with a preview of upcoming news events. Presented two hours before FOX & Friends, the first hour of the program is hosted by Todd Piro and Carley Shimkus

releases.title: GMA3
releases.synopsis: GMA3 is a news, health, lifestyle and shopping program.

releases.title: Making Money with Charles Payne
releases.synopsis: Long-time Wall Street broker and analyst Charles Payne hosts his own daily program Making Money with Charles Payne that helps viewers spot emerging investment prospects. A panel of business and market specialists joins him to discuss the latest headlines, wrap up the day's activities in the markets, and focus on tomorrow's moneymakers. Payne says, "There are money-making opportunities behind every headline." His goal is to help viewers "find their confidence in the markets and realize their long-term dreams and goals."

releases.title: 5 News at Lunchtime
releases.synopsis: The latest national and international news, sport and weather.

releases.title: El Señor de los Cielos
releases.synopsis: Set in the 1990s, these are the life and times of Amado Carrillo Fuentes, a man who became the head of the Juárez cartel. Nicknamed “El Señor de los Cielos” (Lord of the Skies) because of the large fleet of airplanes he used to transport drugs, he was also known for washing more than $200 million through Colombia to finance his huge fleet. He is described as the most powerful drug trafficker of his time.

releases.title: Bloomberg Daybreak: Europe
releases.synopsis: Bloomberg Daybreak: Europe covers all the breaking business news and top stories in the lead-up to the opening of the European markets!

releases.title: CBS Mornings
releases.synopsis: CBS Mornings offers a thoughtful, substantive and insightful source of news and information to a daily audience of 3 million viewers. The Emmy Award-winning broadcast presents a mix of daily news, coverage of developing stories of national and global significance, and interviews with leading figures in politics, business and entertainment.

releases.title: Ash
releases.synopsis: Undercover officer Mo Feihuan unexpectedly crosses paths with Xu Luetao, the CEO of Tianping Group. Drawn together by fate, both men hide behind carefully crafted masks and dangerous secrets. As their true identities are gradually revealed, sweetness turns into suspicion, and even the deepest devotion seems destined to fail. A single careless remark from Xu Luetao shatters their fragile bond. Meanwhile, a major cross-border counterfeit operation exposes a brutal power struggle among local forces, drawing both the underworld and the police into a deadly game. Caught in the eye of the storm, Mo Feihuan and Xu Luetao find that the only person they can truly trust is each other. With every step leading deeper into danger and every moment apart deepening their longing, they stand together against overwhelming odds. Though divided by opposing worlds, their hearts remain destined for the same path.

releases.title: The Last Oath
releases.synopsis: A zombie virus sweeps across the globe, and Lin Zai tragically discovers he carries an immunity, making him targeted by multiple factions. A-Leh, a cold-blooded assassin, is ordered to hunt him down, but when he is critically wounded, Lin Zai saves his life, and the two end up bound to each-other in a post-apocalyptic world.

releases.title: The Pulse
releases.synopsis: Francine Lacqua provides commentary and analysis on the developing stories from around Europe along with a look-ahead to what's likely to dominate the US business agenda.

releases.title: Varney & Company
releases.synopsis: Varney & Company is hosted by veteran business journalist Stuart Varney, noted for his distinctive British accent, hosts this weekday morning program on which he and his guests discuss the implications of political news on the business world, and also how the news of the day affects personal finances. The company Varney keeps includes regular contributors Charles Payne, Sandra Smith and Elizabeth MacDonald, who weigh in on such issues as government spending, health care and bailouts.

releases.title: Today 3rd Hour
releases.synopsis: A news program intended to inform, entertain, inspire and set the agenda each morning. Each daily live broadcast provides current domestic and international news, weather reports, and interviews with newsmakers from the worlds of politics, business, media, entertainment and sports.

releases.title: The Briefing with Jen Psaki
releases.synopsis: Based in Washington, D.C., The Briefing with Jen Psaki will pull from Psaki's decades-long experiences on campaign buses, in the Oval Office, at the State Department, and in the briefing room to dissect the most important stories of the day. Every day the show will aim to help viewers better understand the happenings in Washington and around the country, how it impacts their communities, and what leaders are doing to stand up for the people they represent.

releases.title: CNN NewsNight with Abby Phillip
releases.synopsis: In CNN NewsNight with Abby Phillip, she delivers a thoughtful, sharp approach to the day's biggest stories.

releases.title: 25 Words or Less
releases.synopsis: Hosted by Meredith Vieira, two teams of celebrities and civilians face off in a fast paced word game with a top prize of $10,000.

releases.title: Al Rojo Vivo
releases.synopsis: Al Rojo Vivo is a news magazine that in one hour, takes viewers on a journey through the world. It is an "information paella" that offers something for everyone: local and international news, entertainment, fashion, live interviews, special investigations, human interest, health, consumer alerts and new technology.

releases.title: Fast Money
releases.synopsis: Fast Money is a lively hour of exchange and debate takes place among four of Wall Street's leading traders. Segments include a look at the day's business-related stories in Page Two; the Takedown, in which panelists disagree and argue their points; the Chart of the Day, which offers a look at the stock of the day; and Trade School, in which host Melissa Lee defines Wall Street jargon used by a panelist or a guest.

releases.title: Blue Peter
releases.synopsis: Join Abby, Joel, Shini, Hacker T Dog and pet Henry on epic challenges and exciting adventures as we inspire you to try awesome new activities and earn your Blue Peter badge.

releases.synopsis: In Bloomberg Markets: Balance of Power, host David Gura focuses on the politics and policies being shaped by President Trump's administration.

releases.title: Love Penalty
releases.synopsis: The relationship that began with suspicion became the most dangerous foul. The story of three people that begins the moment they cross the line they should have stopped at.

releases.title: DayDay.
releases.synopsis: A show covering entertainment, trend news, and hot topics, featuring in-depth discussions on relevant issues, real-time viewer polls, the latest weather updates, and horoscopes.

releases.title: Squawk Box
releases.synopsis: Squawk Box is a business news television program that airs at breakfast time on the CNBC network. The program is currently co-hosted by Joe Kernen, Rebecca Quick, and Andrew Ross Sorkin. Since debuting in 1995, the show has spawned a number of versions across CNBC's international channels, many of which employ a similar format. The program title originates from a term used in investment banks and stock brokerages for a permanent voice circuit or intercom used to communicate stock deals or sales priorities; it also may refer to the squawk of a bird, like a peacock, which is the logo of CNBC.

releases.title: Squawk on the Street
releases.synopsis: Squawk on the Street is headquartered live on the floor of the New York Stock Exchange. We are there when the all-important opening bell rings every day. With our exclusive "Eye on the Floor" wireless cameras at the NYSE we take the viewer onto the floor of the exchange, right to the posts where the biggest companies in the world trade. In addition, our exclusive "Tick by Tick" charts track the action of every trade of every stock. Our live market coverage doesn't stop on the corner of Wall and Broad Streets in lower Manhattan. We also have exclusive coverage from the floor of the CME Group in Chicago giving our viewers the treasury, currency and commodity action in real time. In addition, "Squawk on the Street" is also on the air when the closing bells ring throughout Europe. That final hour of European trading starting at 10:30am eastern has proven to be very volatile and has a major impact on all U.S. based markets.

releases.title: Fast Money Halftime Report
releases.synopsis: The hot trades in the market from the floor of the New York Stock Exchange.

releases.title: NBC News Daily
releases.synopsis: NBC News provides viewers with up-to-the-minute national and international news.

releases.title: Oops! Mysterious Sounds
releases.synopsis: A second-hand pair of earphones connects two rivals to the world of the dead. When their idol friend dies under mysterious circumstances, what starts as enemies forced to "fake date" turns into an undeniable bond as they become reluctant partners in a murder investigation. Before the killer... silences them as the next victims. The deeper they dig, the closer they get to death-and to each other. Until they can no longer tell which one is louder: the "voice of the dead" or the "sound of their racing hearts".

releases.title: Power Lunch
releases.synopsis: Power Lunch takes you through the heart of the business day, focusing on real-time market coverage, breaking news and up-to-the-instant stock information. The show delves into the economy, the markets, real estate, media and technology -- any place where there's money to be made. The program features daily contributions from the Nasdaq MarketSite's Times Square studio and coverage from CNBC's Post 9 position on the floor of the New York Stock Exchange, as well as from CNBC's bureaus around the world. "Power Lunch" showcases the best stories of the day from CNBC's roster of digital and television journalists.

releases.title: Masters of the Universe: Tales from Eternia
releases.synopsis: The series introduces a new generation of young fans to the iconic world of Masters of the Universe through fast-paced, action-packed mini adventures. Tales from Eternia delivers high-stakes clashes between He-Man, Skeletor, and Eternia's iconic heroes and villains, bringing the timeless conflict between good and evil to life for today's audiences.

releases.title: Board AF
releases.synopsis: Board AF - the table top game show! We'll be playing all kinds of board & card games - so let us know what you want to see!

releases.title: Closing Bell
releases.synopsis: Anything can happen between the bells of the trading day. But what happens during the last hour could be what matters most. Hosted by CNBC's Scott Wapner, "Closing Bell" guides you through the most important hour of the trading day. The show takes a close-up look at how the markets are moving, what's driving them and how investors are reacting.Live coverage includes reports from the Chicago Board of Trade, New York Mercantile Exchange, NASDAQ and the NYSE. Analysts, money managers and CEOs explain their strategies, share opinions, and provide an inside perspective on breaking news stories.In addition, "Closing Bell" provides instant analysis of corporate profit reports, as soon as they break, during the quarterly earning seasons. Features include interviews with entrepreneurs, plus an inside-look at how executives and high-net-worth individuals spend their time and money.

releases.title: George Clarke's Amazing Spaces: First Home
releases.synopsis: Britain is in the grip of a housing crisis, with many people unable to afford a traditional bricks-and-mortar home. In this new series, George meets the proactive and determined people finding creative ways to put a roof over their heads.Across four episodes, George and his long-time collaborator Will Hardie meet individuals, couples and families driven to create homes in unconventional spaces. From buses and boats to former toilet blocks and tiny homes, the series follows those transforming unexpected places into affordable homes of their own.Through ambitious builds and personal stories, George discovers how hard work, enthusiasm and, sometimes, clever left-field thinking can help turn unlikely spaces into beautiful, practical and life-changing places to live.

releases.title: Against the Current
releases.synopsis: Shen Jia Lan, once a nobleman's granddaughter, falls from grace after her family is falsely accused of treason. Abandoned by her fiancé Lin Jin Qi, she is forced to assume a servant's identity in his household. Despite hardships, she refuses to bow to fate. With resilience and wit, she rises above class barriers, wins Lin Jin Qi's heart, earns the family's respect, and ultimately clears her family's name.

releases.title: A Prophet
releases.synopsis: A mysterious sect manipulates fate to scam the innocent. When revenge driven Shangguan Chengming crosses paths with his enemy Jiang Feiyan again, he sets a trap, using deception against deceivers. But as schemes collide and twists unfold, the game grows more dangerous, who will outsmart whom in the end?

releases.title: Put a Ring on It: Cheathab
releases.synopsis: Put a Ring on It: Cheathab follows long-term couples whose relationships have been rocked by infidelity as they move into the Miami-based "Cheathab House" to confront the trust issues, jealousy, and unresolved wounds threatening their futures. An emotionally charged journey of accountability, difficult choices and redemption.

releases.title: The Source with Kaitlan Collins
releases.synopsis: The Source with Kaitlan Collins - Kaitlan Collins chases the facts, asks the tough questions, and connects with her sources in primetime.

releases.title: Suidooster
releases.synopsis: Suidooster is a South African television soap opera produced by Suidooster Films which revolves around a matriarch, her family, friends and the people of Suidooster, a small shopping and business centre in the fictional Cape Town suburb of Ruiterbosch.

releases.title: Love After Lockup: Relationship Rehab
releases.synopsis: Five fan-favorite couples from the hit Love After Lockup franchise will join psychiatrist and nationally recognized relationship expert, Dr. Ish Major, to repair their broken bonds.

releases.title: TFI Unplugged
releases.synopsis: With the biggest bands performing exclusive intimate sets and unfiltered conversations with A-list celebrity guests, TFI Unplugged is the place where anything can happen. Chris Evans reinvents your favourite television institution for 2026.

releases.title: Fired Up!
releases.synopsis: Chou Lu-yung sets out to uncover the truth behind his father's death while managing the family restaurant, "Chin Lai Hao." He faces life's challenges with his close friends and vows to seek justice for his father.

releases.title: The Producer
releases.synopsis: When an aspiring music producer teams up with a veteran mogul, the unlikely duo sets out to conquer the Mandopop scene.

releases.title: Current with Christine Romans
releases.synopsis: As markets open and the day's biggest stories take shape, anchor Christine Romans will translate breaking developments, politics, global news and the economy to help viewers stay informed and understand what's next. The two-hour program will also feature segments on finance, business, technology, AI and other consequential topics, leveraging Romans' role as NBC News' chief business correspondent.

releases.title: TODAY with Jenna & Sheinelle
releases.synopsis: America's feel-good morning show with big stars and sweet surprises; Jenna Bush Hager and Sheinelle Jones host an hour of heartfelt connection, inspirational stories, fun and laughs.

releases.title: This Much is True Crime
releases.synopsis: Join Britain's leading criminologist, Professor David Wilson, and journalist and TV producer Martin Frizell as they examine the cases everyone is talking about.

releases.title: Make it Right 2026
releases.synopsis: When two high school friends, Fuse and Tee, get drunk together after experiencing unexpected heartbreak, a night of blurred lines transforms their friendship—forcing them, along with their circle of classmates, to navigate the messy, confusing realities of secret romance, identity, and growing up.

releases.title: The Lenticulars
releases.synopsis: Here's my classmates Uta Aihara, Moripura-kun, and friends, who shared joys and sorrows with me during my trainee days, so please do check it out!! A natural, heart-fluttering youth story... but there are intriguing elements everywhere!

releases.title: Teeny Mutant Ninja Turtles
releases.synopsis: Everyone's favorite ninja turtles, Leo, Raph, Donnie, and Mikey, are back! Set in their childhood years, this original series explores the early days of the iconic ninja turtles on their first adventures as ninjas-in-training. They'll even be joined by their friend April O'Neil, and encounter foes like Bebop, Rocksteady, and Karai.

releases.title: Ein Fall für Zwei
releases.synopsis: German crime series, centering around a succession of lawyers and a private investigator and former police officer, who typically team up to clear a client of the lawyer, who is usually an innocent suspect in a murder case.

releases.title: That Time I Got Reincarnated as a Slime
releases.synopsis: Corporate worker Mikami Satoru is stabbed by a random killer, and is reborn to an alternate world. But he turns out to be reborn a slime! Thrown into this new world with the name Rimuru, he begins his quest to create a world that’s welcoming to all races.

releases.title: The Moment with Katy Tur
releases.synopsis: The Moment with Katy Tur is designed to move beyond the immediate headlines to provide deeper context and understanding of the political and national stories shaping the day.

releases.title: The Weeknight
releases.synopsis: One-on-one conversations with politicians and newsmakers, and the breaking issues of the day.

releases.title: ABC Prime with Linsey Davis
releases.synopsis: Providing prime-time context and analysis of the day's top stories, as well as in-depth reporting and storytelling from around the country and the globe.

releases.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! Card Game The Chronicles
releases.synopsis: The stories that lie within the cards come to life...

releases.title: The Patrick Star Show

releases.title: CBS News 24/7
releases.synopsis: Live news and top stories on CBS News 24/7.

releases.title: Medical Examiner Dr. Qin: Bones of the Past
releases.synopsis: While the city is dredging a riverbed, human remains are unearthed. Medical examiner Qin Ming discovers that the victim is a woman from an old case years ago. On Qin Ming's birthday, sunspot activity causes his toy walkie-talkie to connect with his father, Qin Tian, 30 years in the past. Qin Ming warns Qin Tian about an explosion and saves him, but this triggers the Rainy Night Hammer Killer serial case. Two generations of police officers work together across time to solve the case and uncover the truth.

releases.title: Black Island Prison
releases.synopsis: To solve a border missing persons case, Lian Ming, a detective from Lingdong, also infiltrates Black Island Prison undercover. Wen Bang, a former special forces operative from Nanling, is compelled to enter the prison and serve his sentence in order to rescue Yachun and her daughter, who depend on him as much as he depends on them. Behind bars, the two move from mutual hostility to mutual support. As they join forces against the gangs, they must also outwit the mounting crises their true identities create. Even as they slowly expose the prison's criminal truth, a far greater threat is closing in...

releases.title: As Promised
releases.synopsis: He Xiaoyuan, an ordinary palace maid, has been trapped in a cycle of rebirth for thirty-three lifetimes. In every life, she does everything she can to win the heart of Crown Prince Zhao Junyao, only for him to fall for the courtesan Mu Tingting and for her life to end in a palace coup. In her thirty-fourth life, Seventh Prince Zhao Baiqing reveals that their fates are bound together. The cycle can only be broken if he ascends the throne and He Xiaoyuan wins the Crown Prince's true love. To achieve their shared goal, the two form an alliance, with Zhao Baiqing personally coaching He Xiaoyuan on how to capture the Crown Prince's heart. But as fate draws them ever closer, they gradually discover their feelings for each other. In the end, they join forces to unravel the conspiracy, break free from the cycle, and find true love.

releases.title: Bloomberg The Opening Trade
releases.synopsis: Everything you need to know as markets open across Europe. With analysis you won't find anywhere else, we break down the biggest stories of the day and speak to top guests who have skin in the game. Hosted by Anna Edwards, Guy Johnson and Kriti Gupta.

releases.title: Mornings with FOX Business
releases.synopsis: This early show that features a roundtable of rotating industry experts alongside the host. Guests discuss news stories -- domestic and international -- and other topics that are expected to impact the economy and markets that day. The show's intent is to give viewers a jump-start on making moves to get the most out of their investments.

releases.title: State of Play with Peter Alexander
releases.synopsis: State of Play focuses on authoritative and original reporting, thoughtful conversations, and in-depth analysis of the biggest political and national stories shaping the day,

releases.title: The Faulkner Focus
releases.synopsis: Emmy-winning journalist Harris Faulkner provides the latest news driving the day with insightful analysis and interviews with top newsmakers.

releases.title: On the Line with Alicia Menendez

releases.title: America Reports
releases.synopsis: A look at the latest news and headlines with Sandra Smith and John Roberts

releases.title: Bloomberg: The Close
releases.synopsis: Alix Steel, Romaine Bostick and Scarlet Fu own the market-moving breaking news around the closing bell; a synthesis focusing on the final minutes and seconds before and after the closing bell on Wall Street.

releases.title: Fox News @ Night
releases.synopsis: Fox News @ Night is a live hour of hard news and analysis of the most compelling stories from Washington and across the country.

releases.title: The Story Is with Elex Michaelson
releases.synopsis: The Story Is will feature live nightly panels and debates on set featuring a range of voices including attorneys Gloria Allred and Areva Martin, conservative talk radio hosts Larry Elder and Jennifer Horn, progressive podcast host Brian Tyler Cohen, former California GOP chair Jessica Millan Patterson and journalists Peter Hamby from Puck and POLITICO's Melanie Mason.

releases.title: Closing Bell: Overtime
releases.synopsis: A look at after-hours moves, including breaking news, corporate earnings and post-market trading.

releases.title: Искусство падения
releases.synopsis: Dima, a young dancer, participates in a choreographic show and falls under the influence of a strict mentor, Phil. Together with his girlfriend, he becomes a participant in a psychological experiment that Phil puts on all the wards, testing them for their willingness to become real artists. But the dance show doesn't just change them. Renata is a tough and uncompromising producer who sees dancing exclusively as a business. However, her worldview is crumbling under the influence of the powerful energy of the young dancer Anton. As a result, dancing penetrates deeply into the lives of the characters, making them move in every sense of the word.

releases.title: Humoretaten
releases.synopsis: Eight comedians come together to make you laugh, with skits about current events and life itself.

releases.title: Once Upon a Time in Longfan
releases.synopsis: A 20-year-old photo foretells gruesome deaths. Qin Ming must uncover the truth: fate, curse, or calculated murder?

releases.title: Morning Call
releases.synopsis: Morning Call, anchored by Morgan Brennan, delivers the essential market intelligence that drives the trading day ahead. The program captures breaking business news as it unfolds and tracks pre‑market equity moves, commodity swings, U.S. futures, and overnight action across global markets.

releases.title: Bloomberg Businessweek Daily
releases.synopsis: Reporting that helps global leaders stay ahead, plus insight on the people, companies and trends.

releases.title: Brandweer 010
releases.synopsis: Sirens. Smoke. Fire. Life-saving decisions when every second counts. In a raw and unscripted look behind the uniform, cameras follow the first responders of the Rotterdam-Rijnmond fire brigade as career professionals and volunteers risk everything to navigate high-stakes emergencies, intense high-pressure rescues, and the personal toll of life on the front lines.

releases.title: ABC News Live First
releases.synopsis: ABC News Live First will bring streaming viewers the latest headlines, compelling stories, interviews and roundtable discussions.

releases.title: The Big Money Show
releases.synopsis: Taylor Riggs, Brian Brenberg and Jackie DeAngelis host an informative and fast-paced hour filled with business topics that impact everyone from Wall Street to the average person.

releases.title: The Exchange
releases.synopsis: Anchor Kelly Evans reports on the most important stories to today's markets and investors.

releases.title: The Claman Countdown
releases.synopsis: The close of the trading day is covered.

releases.title: Kudlow

releases.title: The Will Cain Show
releases.synopsis: Featuring conversations with newsmakers from across politics, business, culture and sports, The Will Cain Show will offer a comprehensive look at the news of the day in a signature podcast style.

releases.title: The Evening Edit
releases.synopsis: Host Elizabeth MacDonald interviews industry experts to get the inside scoop on the day's leading headlines as they relate to your wallet.

releases.title: ABC News Live Reports

releases.title: Unabomber
releases.synopsis: Follow Ted Kaczynski's transformation from Harvard prodigy into the infamous Unabomber. Subjected to controversial psychological experiments by Professor Henry Murray, Kaczynski's troubled past resurfaces decades later when his manhunt, led by FBI agent Joanne Miller, brings to light the chilling consequences of ambition and isolation.

releases.title: Victorian Psycho
releases.synopsis: When eccentric young governess Winifred Notty arrives at a remote Gothic manor, a string of unsettling events leads the household to suspect she isn't who she claims to be—but the truth may be far more dangerous than they imagine.

releases.title: Spelet
releases.synopsis: Twelve famous Swedes are isolated in a luxury suite at the top of a skyscraper. Monitored 24/7, they navigate a brutal power game where cunning, pacts and betrayal are necessary to avoid being voted out. The rules of the game are simple – but unfair. Both power and money influence the participants in the mini-society created in the suite. One by one, they are ruthlessly voted out by the group until only one winner remains.

releases.title: Meesaya Murukku 2
releases.synopsis: After facing rejection in love and getting into a fight, Jeeva learns about his father Siva's struggles and sacrifices. Inspired by his grandfather's legacy and father's dedication, Jeeva changes his outlook and works hard toward his musical dream. Through determination and perseverance, Jeeva earns recognition in the music industry and brings pride to his family.

releases.title: Your Mother Your Mother Your Mother
releases.synopsis: Latif, a devoutly religious hitman, struggles to balance work, faith and fatherhood. When his wife dies, he embarks on a desperate journey across Houston to protect his children, confronting the forces closing in around him – and the beliefs threatening to unravel within.

releases.title: Love Lottery
releases.synopsis: When a young woman, Bharani Verma, is found dead under mysterious circumstances, the police quickly arrest Kartik Saxena, making him the prime suspect in a seemingly open-and-shut murder case. But as the courtroom battle begins, every testimony uncovers new questions instead of answers. Hidden relationships, conflicting statements, and buried secrets gradually transform a simple murder trial into a gripping mystery where nothing is as it appears. Beyond the suspense, the film also explores a thought-provoking question: Have marriage and legal battles become a silent punishment for some innocent men, or is the truth far more complex than it seems? With every hearing, the truth becomes more elusive, and just when the verdict seems certain, an unexpected twist changes the entire direction of the case. A taut courtroom suspense thriller that keeps the audience guessing until the very last moment.

releases.title: Dorothy
releases.synopsis: Set in a world shaped by caste, violence, and toxic masculinity, two childhood friends grow up inseparable in rural Tamil Nadu. Their lives are transformed by the arrival of Dorothy, a woman whose compassion quietly challenges the world around them.

releases.title: Don't Be Shy!
releases.synopsis: Quintessential Mean Girl, Shyamili ‘Shy’ Das, finds herself suddenly relegated to Loser-ville when Mayank, her boyfriend of three years, suddenly dumps her. But Shy, all set to get her revenge, finds herself falling into friendship and compassion with someone unexpected… Mayank’s new girlfriend - Tara.

releases.title: Buzzkill
releases.synopsis: A group of sorority sisters end up trapped with a murderer. Nora’s tipsy memories hold the clues to figuring out who is killing their friends, but she can only remember them when she’s drunk.

releases.title: Hope Street: One of Our Own
releases.synopsis: A violent crime committed against a much-loved local and the police investigation brings bad news for DS Marlene Pettigrew. Love is also in the air and there’s a wedding to plan, but this is Port Devine, what could possibly go wrong?

releases.title: Family
releases.synopsis: Watching her sick father decline, 11-year-old Johanna makes a call for a good spirit to save him. But something else comes instead.

releases.title: The Lost Children of Tuam
releases.synopsis: When amateur historian Catherine Corless begins examining records from a former Mother and Baby Home in Tuam, Co. Galway, she stumbles upon evidence pointing towards a deeply troubling past. Refusing to let the questions go, she embarks on a painstaking investigation, putting her in conflict with the Church, State, and local town. As official resistance mounts, and unsettling discoveries emerge, her determination challenges powerful institutions, exposing a hidden chapter of Ireland's past that many would rather keep hidden.

releases.title: Long Day's Journey into Night
releases.synopsis: Over the course of a day, a married couple, Mary and James Tyrone, and their two sons, Jamie and Edmund, grapple with Mary's morphine addiction and confront each other over the past in a series of emotionally tense and volatile exchanges.

releases.title: Hellbilly Hollow
releases.synopsis: A team of paranormal YouTubers venture deep into the Alabama backwoods to film at a haunted attraction the day before Halloween. They encounter a sinister presence far more frightening - and deadlier - than specters and staged scares: Tickles and his caretaker brother Bull. One by one, the investigators, together with local thrill-seekers, fall victim!

releases.title: Ballroom
releases.synopsis: A devastating accident forces aspiring dancer Violet to relearn life in a wheelchair. Through dance and an unexpected bond, she discovers that dreams don't disappear - they transform.

releases.title: Kraken

releases.title: Matched: True Love
releases.synopsis: At a secluded island resort, a matchmaking tour turns into a deadly game when buried secrets surface — forcing a survivor of past app-related murders to fight for her life once again.

releases.title: Butterfly
releases.synopsis: Two sisters raised on a charter resort in Gran Canaria. After 27 years, they reluctantly return to their childhood island to deal with their parents death, and end up with a half-finished esoteric retreat center in the Canary Islands.

releases.title: Dunhuang Warriors
releases.synopsis: During a time of unrest in Shazhou, a once-prosperous Tang Dynasty outpost now under Tibetan control, a rebellion led by Zhang Yichao sparks hope for liberation. As the conflict intensifies, a group of unlikely heroes—including a thief, a deserter, and a general’s daughter—unite to fight for their people’s freedom.

releases.title: Echoes
releases.synopsis: Alba spends her days shut away in her apartment. Amidst oppressive silences and sudden outbursts of anger, her mind drifts ceaselessly between the present and the past.

releases.title: + Add Friend

releases.title: Mila/Marija

releases.title: Pulp: What Do You Do for an Encore?
releases.synopsis: A fusion of the brilliantly choreographed stage spectacle of Pulp’s biggest ever arena show — part of the global tour for More, the band’s first album in 24 years — with four decades of colorful, never-seen-before archival material.

releases.title: Acharya
releases.synopsis: An ex-Army man takes on a contract to rescue a young woman stranded in Mumbai and bring her safely back to Nepal. What begins as a straightforward rescue mission soon turns into a dangerous and unexpected journey.

releases.title: The Deputy
releases.synopsis: A young sheriff's deputy finds himself in the crosshairs of dangerous criminals when the dead body he is assigned to keep an eye on disappears from a crime scene.

releases.title: Stupid August
releases.synopsis: The tale of an amnesiac clown lost in the Ireland of the 1960s. A silent historical fantasy that utilises elements of fact and conjecture and mixes them in a hybrid of expressionism, surrealism and pantomime.

releases.title: We Are Aliens
releases.synopsis: One summer in the third grade, a quiet boy named Tsubasa meets Gyotaro, a boy everyone in the class looked up to, and the two become close friends. Within their small world, they share irreplaceable moments—until a small incident suddenly tears them apart.

releases.title: Ut Lan 2
releases.synopsis: Since the appearance of a two-headed snake, a riverside village is plagued by a series of mysterious deaths. As long-forgotten secrets slowly rise to the surface, the villagers realize that some curses never truly disappear.

releases.title: The Journey of Heroes
releases.synopsis: The Journey of Heroes follows Ny (Steven Nguyễn), who, after rescuing his younger sister from a human trafficking ring along the Western border, is captured alongside his best friend and forced into slavery inside a brutal scam compound. There, together with undercover investigators and fellow victims suffering in silence, they secretly devise a daring plan to escape.

releases.title: Jadau

releases.title: Mission D.D.L.J.

releases.title: Bloody Tennis

releases.title: Salmones Rosas

releases.title: Spark

releases.title: O'Slaughter Day
releases.synopsis: The day before Christmas, the Veterinary Board receives a positive A test result from a wild boar shot by a hunter. The young veterinary officer has a disposal machine ready and starts touring the farms in his former home village. The very first farm in Kiuma village is home to the elderly and childless Ants and Minna. For the couple, their domestic animals are a substitute for their missing children and loved ones. At the same time, Ants' nephews arrive with their wives and children. The goal is to quickly deliver the gifts and drive back home to the city. But the farmer Ants announces the situation he is in with his animals, and now he needs the help of his relatives to slaughter the pigs.

releases.title: Good Trip
releases.synopsis: Shan, an art assistant, juggles responsibilities on the film set and at the hospital, where she cares for her father, Kueng, who has cancer. During her time at the hospital, Shan is tasked by the crew to collect a big bowl from the prop-studio. At her father's request, they discreetly leave the hospital together, embarking on an unexpected journey from the studio to Macau, and subsequently to Okinawa, allowing Kueng to address his unfulfilled wishes. Following his peaceful passing, Shan inherits not only memories but also a lasting sense of courage, optimism, and imaginative spirit that sustains her throughout life.

releases.synopsis: Sofia works as a location scout for a TV pilot filming in New York City. It’s her job to find the homes, businesses, and exteriors where the show will be filmed. Driving around the city's different neighborhoods, she enters the private spaces of strangers to photograph their cozy apartments and eclectic shops, stepping into the fabric of their lives while trying to satisfy the demands of her erratic employers. Over a day filled with these encounters, Sofia witnesses moments of curiosity, vulnerability, and quiet tension until her work takes a sudden, personal turn.

As the day unfolds, familiar moments begin to repeat and reality becomes increasingly difficult to distinguish from memory. Realizing that something is terribly wrong, Kuttan races to uncover the truth before the day repeats itself again.

releases.title: Spidey and the Avengers: Halloween Team-Up!
releases.synopsis: Spidey and the Avengers' Halloween plans are turned upside down by the mysterious Hallows' Eve, who plays magical tricks on trick or treaters and plans to ruin Halloween forever.

releases.title: Beasts Clutching at Straws
releases.synopsis: Wara nimo Sugaru Kemono tachi (藁にもすがる獣たち / Beasts Clutching at Straws) is a 2026 Japanese neo-noir crime suspense thriller directed by Hideo Jojo and written by Yasuko Kobayashi. Based on Keisuke Sone's 2011 novel, the film is set for a nationwide theatrical release in Japan on September 25, 2026, distributed by Toei.  The story centers on a lost gym bag containing 100 million yen in cash found at an internet café by a struggling YouTuber living with his ailing grandmother. The discovery triggers a chaotic and violent chain reaction, entwining a corrupt police officer indebted to the Yakuza, a scheming femme fatale, and ruthless criminals all fighting to claim the fortune. The ensemble cast stars Oji Suzuka, Hiroki Narimiya, Nana Mori, MEGUMI, and Jun Fubuki.

releases.title: 300 Oaks

In the Arantzazu crypt, 23 chefs from Mahaia Kolektiboa meet artists in an immersive experience to address a crucial question: how to sustain an own identity today.

Mallory stays at a BnB run by Robin and her charming son Wren, a former Marine. Beneath her exterior, Mallory’s warm side is revealed as she bonds with the community, especially Wren. Zeke, Mallory’s best friend and Hollywood heartthrob, visits her there and challenges her to rethink what she really wants.

releases.title: Perfect Road

releases.title: Strindbergs Ensam
releases.synopsis: Based on Strindberg's autobiographical book of the same name. Is it better to self isolate than to put in all the work it takes to maintain a social life?

releases.title: Stolen Birthday
releases.synopsis: On his birthday, Ronnie, a lonely middle-aged man, sits in a small diner having dinner with his mother, Julie. For Ronnie, the moment feels warm and real. They talk, laugh, and share the kind of comfort that only comes from being with someone who knows you deeply. As the night continues, small details begin to feel off. The people around Ronnie react to him with confusion, and it slowly becomes clear that Julie is not actually sitting across from him. The birthday dinner exists only in Ronnie's mind. In reality, he is homeless, alone, and struggling with his mental health. When the illusion begins to fall apart, Ronnie is forced back into the world he has been trying to escape. What felt like a simple birthday dinner becomes a heartbreaking look at grief, loneliness, and the ways people create their own sense of comfort when reality becomes too painful.

releases.title: Nightgame

releases.title: Lenin Pandiyan
releases.synopsis: In rural Tamil Nadu, ageing farmer Durairasu and young police constable Maravarman Sundarapandian become embroiled in an illegal sand mining scandal.

releases.title: Shadows of Beirut
releases.synopsis: A young woman decides to return to Beirut to see her estranged dying father after 25 years. Between the struggle to forgive him and building up the courage to face him, she discovers the heart of her homeland through the people she meets.

releases.title: (im)perfect strangers

releases.title: Premada Oorali

The album captures the fallout of love, guilt and self-destruction across 11 volatile tracks including the explosive single 'That's Me'. releases.title: The Other
releases.synopsis: A short mystery horror film written and directed by filmmaker Hakeem Ahmed.  What begins as an ordinary Saturday for Salim quickly takes a disturbing turn when he notices someone is following him.  A stranger.  The same clothes.  The same places.  Always there.  An unsettling coincidence soon becomes something far more disturbing.  As the day descends into paranoia and fear, Salim is finally forced to confront the person who has been stalking him. Since the centre of attention is constantly deferred, the only way to watch the film 'properly' is to stop watching full-stop: to pause and look at the stills. So the paradox goes. The story is simple: a time-travelling 'aconceptualist' goes back in time, in an attempt to stop his joke of an art movement getting taken seriously. He finds himself on a beach from his childhood.

releases.title: Dear Debbie
releases.synopsis:
Sometimes, enough is enough…

Debbie Mullen is losing it. For years, she has compiled all of her best advice into her column, Dear Debbie, where the wives of New England come for sympathy and neighborly advice. Through her work, Debbie has heard from countless women who are ignored, belittled, or even abused by their husbands. And Debbie does her best to guide them in the right direction. Or at least, she did.

These days, Debbie’s life seems to be spiraling out of control. She just lost her job. Something strange is happening with her teenage daughters. And her husband is keeping secrets, according to the tracking app she installed on his phone. Now, Debbie’s done being the bigger person.

She’s done being reasonable and practical. It’s time to take her own advice.

And now it’s time for payback against all the people in her life who deserve it the most.

releases.title: Persona
releases.synopsis:
**A trans woman discovers pornography of herself she has no memory of making, only to find herself led to an unimaginably deeper evil.**

A feral shut-in discovers a disturbing internet porn video of what seems to be herself. A seance of coked-up artists summons unearthly forces in a studio apartment. The staircase of an exurban marketing company descends endlessly beneath the earth. 

In Aoife Josie Clements’ electric, nightmarish, intricately layered novel, the impossibility of goodness crowds in upon two young trans women barely surviving on sex work and zero-hours contracts. Below the familiar evils of capitalism and the bottomless depths of internet culture, a darker horror awaits. What curse follows these women? What are they escaping? What are they running towards?

releases.title: The Man Who Vanished
releases.synopsis:
**What would you become  if no one could see you?**

A gripping psychological thriller of invisibility, obsession, and power. Deep within Egypt, a discovery changes everything. When I encounter something never meant to be found, my world fractures. I vanish from sight—but not from consequence. Liberation mutates into obsession, freedom into a mind slipping beyond control.

Unseen, I move through the world’s shadows—navigating criminal networks, exposing hidden conspiracies, unearthing truths buried for centuries. Invisibility becomes more than an ability: it becomes temptation, weapon, and curse.

Each step deeper into the unseen erodes the boundaries between justice and transgression, control and compulsion. But the greatest danger is not the enemies I pursue. It is the darkness awakening within me. As curiosity hardens into obsession, morality fractures.

Some hungers leave scars you cannot see. And when power begins to consume rather than empower, survival becomes a battle not only against those who hunt me—but against the consequences of everything I have done. 

The Man Who Vanished is a gripping psychological thriller fused with political intrigue, conspiracies and espionage suspense. Relentless tension meets psychological depth in a story about invisibility, obsession, and the devastating cost of crossing unseen lines.

Perfect for readers who love:

✔ Psychological thrillers
✔ Political and conspiracy thrillers
✔ Espionage and spy fiction
✔ Dark suspense and moral dilemmas
✔ High-stakes international intrigue

Fans of high-tension, mind-bending thrillers and stories of identity, secrecy, and psychological descent will be captivated by its atmosphere, intensity, and escalating suspense. 
Are you ready to vanish into the unseen?

Notice: Contains mature themes and strong scenes intended for mature readers.

releases.title: Titanium, The Life & Memoirs Of Toby Ti Mustard
releases.synopsis: Titanium: Life of X is a raw, visionary memoir by ordained minister and creative leader Toby Ti Mustard. This spiritual autobiography traces a journey of awakening, reincarnation, and resilience — a life forged in silence, shaped by struggle, and elevated by purpose. Set against the backdrop of Ross County, Ohio, Toby’s story unfolds through mystical insight, personal transformation, and a calling to serve. Titanium is not just a book — it’s a declaration of identity, a spiritual blueprint, and a testament to the unbreakable force of becoming.

releases.synopsis:
Lillian and Henry have been enjoying each other’s company, especially in bed. Even though Lillian’s best friend calls it “situationship,” Lillian is determined to lock Henry down—and she has a plan. She’ll be the best, most accommodating version of herself until he falls in love with her. But when Henry blindsides Lillian with a breakup, Lillian exacts revenge by performing a drunken hex on him.

Lillian expects Henry to come crawling back to her. What she doesn’t quite anticipate is becoming a prime suspect in his murder case when he’s found dead. As Lillian grapples with the loss of her sort-of-boyfriend, she’s hit with another reckoning: That Henry had a long-term girlfriend he also left behind.

Desperate to control the narrative, clear her name, and assume her rightful place as Henry’s mourning girlfriend, Lillian’s pursuit of the truth will throw her into a dangerous tailspin.

releases.title: The Escape Game
releases.synopsis:
**It’s all fun and games until someone ends up dead.**

Six months ago, season four of The Escape Game ended in horror when contestant Alicia Angelos was found murdered on set.

Now season five is underway, and new contestants are ready to put their skills to the test solving the show's trickiest escape rooms. There's Adi, the cryptographer; Carter, the math whiz; Beck, the wannabe game master; and . . . Sierra Angelos, the girl who got away with her sister’s murder. Or so everyone believes.

But Sierra’s not just here to win. She’s here for justice.

When the contestants begin uncovering clues that hint at the identity of Alicia’s true killer, it becomes clear that the stakes aren’t high just in this competition—they’re deadly. If these teens want to win—and survive—the game, they must solve the biggest mystery of all: who killed Alicia Angelos?
